title.narrative: Investment Support to the Kutaisi Waste Water Project (KWWP)

description.narrative: The Project's objective is to collect and treat the wastewater of Kutaisi, the second largest city in Georgia. The sewerage network will be rehabilitated and a new wastewater treatment plant will be built. The EU grant will be used for the environmental/climate change component which consists in the treatment and digestion of the sludge generated during the wastewater treatment process to produce biogas to be used to produce heat and electricity and soil fertilisers to be used in agriculture
